# "eraser" venv: the interpreter behind the subtitle-eraser pack, which runs
# YaoFANGUK/video-subtitle-remover's backend (ERASER_PYTHON / ERASER_VSR_DIR
# in kit.env) to paint burned-in subtitles out of a video.
#
# A venv of its own, not the engines one: the eraser's OCR and inpainting code
# is verified against torch 2.7.0 / torchvision 0.22.0, older than the engines
# venv's 2.8.0 pair, and the two cannot share one environment.
#
# torch/torchvision are NOT listed here. installSpec.js (buildSteps:
# torchEraser) installs them first -- on Windows from the pytorch.org cu128 or
# cpu index, on macOS from PyPI, which is where the MPS wheel comes from.
#
# paddlepaddle is the CPU build on BOTH platforms: paddlepaddle-gpu is served
# only from Paddle's own China-hosted index, which no user install can rely on.
# Deliberately absent, both verified on Windows 2026-09-09: onnxruntime-directml
# (the OCR step dies on it) and onnxruntime-gpu.
filesplit==3.0.2
opencv-python==4.11.0.86
opencv-contrib-python==4.10.0.84
scikit-image==0.25.2
tqdm==4.67.1
pyside6-fluent-widgets==1.7.7
PySide6==6.11.2
numpy==2.2.5
av==17.0.0
einops==0.8.1
paddleocr==3.4.0
paddlex==3.4.3
paddlepaddle==3.0.0
pillow==12.3.0
scipy==1.17.1
shapely==2.1.2
pyclipper==1.4.0
imageio==2.37.4
matplotlib
requests
darkdetect
